version_filter.py.summary: Delete the outdated and the unwanted wheel files of the current directory.
details: Parses the ``name-version-python-tag.whl`` names, keeps only the newest dated build of each package and also removes the ``py3-none-any`` builds of the packages on the blocklist (pycryptodome, matplotlib), printing every deletion.

wfreq.py.summary: Collect the words missing from the dictionary into ``~/.personal_dict``.
details: Extracts the words from the text files below the current directory in a process pool, keeps the ones the ``spellchecker`` does not know and appends them to the personal dictionary used by the spelling checks.
Re-saves each font with the ``woff`` flavour through fontTools, gives a unique name when the target exists, deletes the source and converts in parallel.
Loads each ``.woff`` font, saves it with the ``woff2`` flavour next to the source, removes the original and works through the files in a pool.

word_freq_counter.py.summary: Count the word frequencies of the files below the current directory.
details: Matches the lowercase words of each text file, counts them in a process pool and writes the totals with a timestamp to ``counter.json``.

wrapper_gh.py.summary: Wrap the ``gh`` CLI so every invocation is logged.
details: Finds the real ``gh`` binary, appends the command, the arguments, the exit status and the duration to a dated log file under ``~/tmp/log/apps`` and passes the output through unchanged.
wrapper_gh.py.notes: Meant to shadow ``gh`` on ``PATH``; keep the real binary reachable at the path it probes.

wtmp.py.summary: Copy the new archives dropped into a directory to ``~/tmp/tgz``.
details: Scans the watched directory (``$PREFIX/tmp`` by default) once, then uses watchdog to copy every newly created or modified ``.tar.gz``/``.tar.xz``/``.tar.bz2``/``.zip``/``.whl`` file into ``~/tmp/tgz``.

ww.py.summary: Build a wheel from the current directory into ``/sdcard/whl``.
details: Changes to the parent directory and runs ``wheel pack`` on the current one with ``-d /sdcard/whl`` as the destination.

www.py.summary: Move every ``.whl`` below the current directory to ``/sdcard/whl``.
details: Finds the wheels recursively, overwrites the targets of the same name in ``/sdcard/whl`` and deletes the source copies.

xbase64_assets.py.summary: Extract the base64-encoded assets of HTML/CSS/JS sources into the ``assets`` folder.
details: Detects the ``data:`` URIs with tree-sitter or regexes, guesses the MIME type from the decoded signature, writes the assets into per-kind subdirectories with content-hashed names and can replace the URIs with the new paths, processing the tree concurrently with a JSON report.

xem.py.summary: Extract the ``data:`` URIs of HTML files into ``extracted_base64``.
details: Finds the base64 data URLs, decodes them, names the files after a content hash with the extension inferred from the MIME type and writes them to ``extracted_base64``, skipping the duplicates.

xemoji.py.summary: Collect the emoji used by the files of the current directory into ``emojis.json``.
details: Scans the files (20 MB limit, UTF-8 only) with a regex that covers the pictographic blocks, the variation selectors, the skin tones, the ZWJ sequences and the regional indicators and writes the sorted ``U+XXXX`` keys with their glyph to ``emojis.json``.

xentity.py.summary: Split the constants, classes, functions and imports of the given sources into separate files.
details: Parses Python with ast, libcst or tree-sitter (``--backend``), classifies every top-level definition and writes the groups into ``output/`` as ``const.py``, ``classes.py``, ``funcs.py`` and ``imports.py``; the ``--const``/``--class``/``--function``/``--import`` flags restrict the kinds that are extracted.

xenv_vars.py.summary: List the environment variable names assigned in the files of the current directory.
details: Matches the ``NAME=`` lines (``.git`` excluded), collects the unique upper-case names and writes them sorted to ``env_vars.txt``.
